[[File:Anna POKÉTOON.png|thumb|Anna]] '''Anna''' (Japanese: '''アンナ''' ''Anna'') is a character who appeared in ''[[PT05|The Slugma-Powered Home]]'', the fifth episode of the [[POKÉTOON]] animated shorts. She was seen visiting her grandparents' house and took a liking to the {{p|Slugma}} that was keeping the house warm. While she was dismayed that she could not touch Slugma due to its hot body, she was still happy to become friends with it by the end of the episode. ==Pokémon== ===Befriended=== {{TrainerPoké |pkmn=Darumaka, Minccino, and Joltik |type1=??? |img=Anna Grandparents Pokemon.png |epnum=PT05 |epname=The Slugma-Powered Home |desc=These {{p|Darumaka}}, {{p|Minccino}}, and {{p|Joltik}} belong to Anna's grandparents. As she went looking for {{p|Slugma}}, these Pokémon started to follow her.
